blind.B1: No. GSE344550 is human macrophages infected ex vivo with C. parapsilosis isolates (FN.p1, S4.10.p2, S2.7.p1); no exercise, training or activity factor anywhere. No sample carries an exercise factor. Refuse.
blind.B2: BP (1T, 35B) vs LBP (29T, 49B) infected macrophages at 3 h and 24 h, normalized to uninfected controls (S2.7.p1, S4.13.p1). Per-group n is not stated in the text; GEO has 30 libraries (controls 8, BP 10, LBP 12).
blind.B3: Paper does not describe donors or repeated sampling for the macrophage RNA-seq. Titles carry only strain/time/rep; the strain+rep-suffix key is a label coincidence and the expression check says not_supported (p=0.40). No supported repeated-measures unit.
blind.B4: One model on all samples: edgeR design ~0 + group:time, then BP vs LBP tested at 3 h and 24 h (S4.13.p1).
blind.B5: Only 'Significant differentially expressed genes were defined as genes showing with |log2FC| > 1' (S4.13.p1); no p or FDR rule stated. No macrophage DEG counts in text; results given as fgsea/GSEA (Fig 5, S4 Fig).

checks.evidence: Study is pathogen-infection of macrophages; no exercise arm (FN.p1, S4.10.p2). Refusal matches B1.
No contrast run; bgrp mapping (BP 1T/35B, LBP 29T/49B, CTRL 8) matches S4.13.p1.
Candidate strain+title-suffix key is not_supported by expression (permutation p=0.396) and paper is silent on donors; moot given refusal.
No fit run; paper used one joint edgeR model ~0+group:time.
Not applicable without an exercise factor; control labelled at three time labels recorded.
File named counts_rpkm, data_processing says RPKM, integer fraction 0.55; typed RPKM, limma on log2(RPKM+1). Paper used raw counts not deposited; recorded.
Recorded |log2FC|>1 with no p/FDR rule, matching S4.13.p1.
No ours-vs-paper comparison claimed; HANDBACK says not applicable.
'No exercise arm' is true and established from paper and the full metadata (all 30 titles, strain/time), not a narrow search.

human_items: Whether ex vivo pathogen-infection series like this count as exercise studies is moot here (no exercise mediator either).
summary: 该系列是人巨噬细胞感染念珠菌的数据，论文与元数据都没有运动因素，拒绝分析的理由成立且依据充分。矩阵类型（RPKM）、阈值（仅 |log2FC|>1）和论文与数据的差异均记录准确。未发现阻断或重要问题。
